description:
# Context

This fixture represents a ticket with many supporting documents. The prompt should stay compact because the read-first summary lives in the attachment README instead of being duplicated inline.

## Proposed Approach

- Persist the attachment README with a prioritized summary.
- Keep the full manifest below that summary.
- Point turn one at the manifest path instead of dumping the attachment list into the prompt body.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Attachment context remains reviewer-readable
- [ ] Prompt stays compact even when attachment context is large

## Validation

- `cargo test render_issue_attachment_manifest_adds_prioritized_summary --lib -- --exact`
